name: docs-e2e
// e2e: The plugin's inferred inputs hash the suite and the app's sources, not the site's content: `apps/docs/src/generated` is written by `docs:content` from files outside both projects (docs/acr.md, docs/lessons.md, the cards). So a report that changed on 2026-09-16 met a suite still passing from cache until 2026-09-17 (lesson-221). Depending on `content` and hashing its outputs puts the rendered content into the key.
